channel.title: CVE Daily — AI Curated
channel.description: Today's curated vulnerabilities emphasize critical security gaps in cloud infrastructure, web services, and network equipment, where remote code execution and authentication bypasses represent the most prevalent attack methods. High-profile products including Keycloak, Traefik, and Samba suffer from flaws enabling credential forgery and command injection, while extensive memory corruption bugs in the Linux kernel and desktop components continue to drive local privilege escalation and denial-of-service conditions. Cloud environments face distinct dangers through container breakout vulnerabilities in LXD and Kubernetes ecosystems, alongside hypervisor weaknesses in VMware ESXi that risk full infrastructure takeover. The report also identifies significant risks in industrial control and IoT sectors stemming from hardcoded secrets and insufficient input validation, reflecting a broad trend of misconfigurations and logic errors across enterprise software.

item.title: CVE-2026-137457 — Desktop OS
item.description: FreeRDP's missing authentication in shadow server fast-path input handlers allows unauthenticated attackers to inject keystrokes and mouse events before session activation, severely compromising remote desktop security.

item.title: CVE-2025-62229 — Desktop OS
item.description: Improper error handling in the X.Org Xserver X11 Present extension leaves dangling pointers that trigger use-after-free conditions during notification creation, potentially enabling local privilege escalation or system crashes.

item.title: CVE-2026-132150 — Desktop OS
item.description: GIMP's XMC plugin processes unvalidated comment subtypes as array indices, triggering out-of-bounds reads and use-after-free vulnerabilities that can crash the application or leak memory.

item.title: CVE-2026-34001 — Desktop OS
item.description: A use-after-free flaw in the X.Org X server's fence triggering logic allows local attackers to destabilize the display environment or escalate privileges without user interaction.

item.title: CVE-2026-80 — Desktop OS
item.description: The privileged gvfsd-admin daemon uses link-following chown() on user-controlled directories, enabling local privilege escalation through time-of-check-to-time-of-use race conditions.

item.title: CVE-2026-50264 — Desktop OS
item.description: Out-of-bounds heap write in the X.Org X server allows local attackers to crash the display server or potentially escalate privileges by manipulating DRI2 buffer attachments.

item.title: CVE-2026-12856 — Desktop OS
item.description: The vscode-java extension blindly trusts Markdown content in JavaDoc hovers, enabling attackers to execute hidden commands when developers interact with maliciously crafted source files.

item.title: CVE-2025-49180 — Desktop OS
item.description: Integer overflow in the X.org RandR extension's property change function allows client applications to bypass size checks, leading to memory corruption and potential graphical subsystem exploitation.

item.title: CVE-2023-5633 — Desktop OS
item.description: Local unprivileged users can exploit a use-after-free in VMware guest 3D acceleration to crash the system or escalate privileges in desktop virtualization environments.

item.title: CVE-2026-136760 — Desktop OS
item.description: Panorama Suite HMI desktop interfaces allow LDAP injection bypasses, compromising authentication and granting unauthorized access to business logic areas.

item.title: CVE-2026-50610 — Desktop OS
item.description: Local privilege escalation via insufficient access controls in Acer's NitroSense service allows unauthorized registry modifications by authenticated users.

item.title: CVE-2026-109832 — Desktop OS
item.description: Unhandled retryable TLS states cause an unbounded busy loop, enabling remote denial-of-service against enabled GNOME Remote Desktop VNC sessions.

item.title: CVE-2026-136950 — Desktop OS
item.description: Improper handling of OSC 8 escape sequences in the terminal emulator allows remote attackers to inject malicious hyperlinks and manipulate terminal state.

item.title: CVE-2026-118076 — Mobile Security
item.description: Frisbii Pay Android application embeds static API credentials in the APK, enabling attackers to forge requests and bypass authentication mechanisms.

item.title: CVE-2026-127041 — Mobile Security
item.description: Bizum Pay for Android hardcodes cryptographic signing values, allowing attackers to extract secrets and manipulate payment transactions without proper verification.

item.title: CVE-2026-49188 — Mobile Security
item.description: The ai_cmd utility runs with root privileges and passes unsanitized socket data directly to popen(), enabling unauthenticated remote command execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-49186 — Mobile Security
item.description: Lack of topic-level ACLs in the local MQTT broker allows any client to subscribe via wildcards, facilitating network device enumeration and rogue command publication.

item.title: CVE-2026-0980 — IoT Security
item.description: A flaw in the rubyipmi gem used by Red Hat Satellite's BMC component allows authenticated attackers to craft malicious usernames that trigger remote code execution on baseboard management controllers, compromising hardware-level infrastructure access.

item.title: CVE-2026-124284 — IoT Security
item.description: Critical authentication bypasses in Genetec Security Center's OIDC, SAML, and AD FS integrations directly compromise physical access control and surveillance infrastructure.

item.title: CVE-2026-137587 — IoT Security
item.description: Trusting attacker-controlled length fields in LIVE555's Vorbis/Theora configuration parser triggers heap out-of-bounds reads, risking information leakage or denial of service in RTSP/NVR deployments.

item.title: CVE-2026-50211 — IoT Security
item.description: Exposed factory diagnostic interfaces on retail hardware grant malicious applications direct write access to critical NVRAM registers, compromising device integrity.

item.title: CVE-2026-50209 — IoT Security
item.description: Maliciously triggered broadcast events can overwrite the device's MDM endpoint, effectively hijacking administrative control and shifting ownership to attackers.

item.title: CVE-2026-128796 — IoT Security
item.description: An overly permissive system service allows any installed application to send arbitrary AT commands to the baseband modem, exposing sensitive identifiers like IMEI and IMSI.

item.title: CVE-2026-135384 — Cloud Security
item.description: Canonical LXD's improper OIDC bearer token verification allows remote attackers holding valid identity provider tokens to authenticate to the LXD API, gaining unauthorized container control or user impersonation capabilities.

item.title: CVE-2026-136976 — Cloud Security
item.description: LXD's recursive file pull feature suffers from improper link resolution on case-insensitive filesystems, enabling authenticated users to escape container boundaries and write arbitrary files to the host system.

item.title: CVE-2026-75885 — Cloud Security
item.description: Unauthenticated access to OpenShift console devfile endpoints can be exploited for SSRF against internal cluster services, potentially exposing sensitive workloads.

item.title: CVE-2026-66794 — Cloud Security
item.description: URL path manipulation in the cluster-proxy-addon bypasses authentication and authorization checks, granting unauthorized access to internal management routes.

item.title: CVE-2026-137499 — Cloud Security
item.description: Budibase's OIDC account linking flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to hijack global builder accounts by asserting email_verified=false at trusted identity providers.

item.title: CVE-2026-75887 — Cloud Security
item.description: Path traversal via query parameters in the OpenShift console leaks sensitive pod filesystem files, including configuration secrets and deployment manifests.

item.title: CVE-2026-16242 — Cloud Security
item.description: Missing cluster CA certificate and token validation in the Konnectivity proxy allows unauthenticated remote attackers to intercept or manipulate control plane traffic, compromising Kubernetes security.

item.title: CVE-2026-15416 — Cloud Security
item.description: Argo CD's repo-server exposes an unauthenticated remote code execution vector that could allow attackers to deploy malicious applications directly into GitOps-managed clusters.

item.title: CVE-2026-10059 — Cloud Security
item.description: Namespace-scoped tenant administrators can exploit the ClusterCurator controller to mint privileged tokens, effectively escalating from namespace limits to full cluster administration.

item.title: CVE-2026-15378 — Cloud Security
item.description: Blind SSRF in the guardrails-detectors component enables remote attackers to exfiltrate sensitive cloud credentials and internal metadata by injecting crafted XML Schema strings.

item.title: CVE-2024-11218 — Cloud Security
item.description: Podman Build race conditions enable container breakout and host filesystem enumeration, directly threatening containerized workload isolation.

item.title: CVE-2024-5154 — Cloud Security
item.description: cri-o directory traversal allows malicious containers to read and write arbitrary host files, breaking fundamental container security boundaries.

item.title: CVE-2026-123911 — Cloud Security
item.description: VMware ESXi I/O filter service use-after-free can lead to critical hypervisor compromise and virtual machine escape in cloud infrastructures.

item.title: CVE-2026-137566 — Cloud Security
item.description: Argo Workflows path traversal in artifact drivers allows attackers to overwrite sensitive files across connected cloud storage buckets.

item.title: CVE-2025-12548 — Cloud Security
item.description: An exposed JSON-RPC API permits unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary commands and exfiltrate secrets from isolated developer workspaces.

item.title: CVE-2026-133469 — Cloud Security
item.description: Flawed REST cookie parsing bypasses authentication checks, allowing unauthenticated attackers to gain administrative control over XCP-ng virtualization infrastructure.

item.title: CVE-2026-115576 — Cloud Security
item.description: The unauthenticated local gRPC control interface enables local processes to manipulate zero-trust network configurations, risking lateral movement and policy bypass.

item.title: CVE-2026-66784 — Cloud Security
item.description: CVSS 8.7 highlights a critical flaw in Submariner's default PSK configuration, enabling attackers to forge cluster identities and potentially hijack multi-cluster Kubernetes communications.

item.title: CVE-2023-3961 — Network Devices
item.description: Samba's path traversal vulnerability in Unix domain socket pipe name processing allows attackers to write arbitrary files within private directories, potentially compromising SMB/CIFS services and associated RPC daemons.

item.title: CVE-2026-35091 — Network Devices
item.description: Corosync's membership commit token sanity check flaw allows unauthenticated remote attackers to trigger out-of-bounds reads via crafted UDP packets, causing cluster service crashes and denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2026-137481 — Network Devices
item.description: Traefik's sanitizePath option fails to resolve dot-segments, allowing attackers to bypass router matching rules and apply unauthorized middlewares to traffic.

item.title: CVE-2026-93491 — Network Devices
item.description: Netty's HttpServerCodec lacks read enforcement during HTTP pipelining, causing unbounded queue growth that exhausts heap memory and triggers service disruption.

item.title: CVE-2026-82 — Network Devices
item.description: Corosync's Totem message reassembly omits runtime bounds checks in release builds, exposing multicast clustering protocols to heap corruption and potential remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-4480 — Network Devices
item.description: Samba's printing subsystem passes unescaped job descriptions to shell commands, allowing remote attackers to achieve arbitrary command execution via specially crafted print requests.

item.title: CVE-2026-4408 — Network Devices
item.description: Misconfigured password scripts using the %u substitution character pass unescaped usernames to shell contexts, granting remote attackers direct command execution capabilities on domain controllers.

item.title: CVE-2026-1933 — Network Devices
item.description: Missing SMB-layer access checks on NTFS-style reparse points allow authenticated users to bypass read-only share restrictions, enabling unauthorized metadata modification.

item.title: CVE-2023-5178 — Network Devices
item.description: Linux kernel NVMe/TCP subsystem logical bug causes use-after-free, potentially permitting remote code execution on network-attached storage controllers.

item.title: CVE-2023-4147 — Network Devices
item.description: Linux kernel Netfilter use-after-free when adding chain rules allows local privilege escalation or system crashes in network filtering stacks.

item.title: CVE-2023-4387 — Network Devices
item.description: VMware vmxnet3 NIC driver double-free vulnerability can crash the host system or escalate privileges in virtualized network environments.

item.title: CVE-2026-103406 — Network Devices
item.description: Insufficient validation of the salt minion ID in the provisioning component allows remote attackers to achieve root-level command execution on network controllers.

item.title: CVE-2026-133323 — Network Devices
item.description: Unsanitized parameters in the conferencing component enable blind command injection, allowing unauthenticated attackers to fully compromise the underlying server.

item.title: CVE-2026-133993 — Network Devices
item.description: A remotely exploitable stack-based buffer overflow in the GENA subscription handler can lead to complete device compromise and network disruption.

item.title: CVE-2023-25915 — Industrial Control
item.description: Critical input validation flaws in the industrial controller allow authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary system commands, jeopardizing operational technology environments.

item.title: CVE-2025-41450 — Industrial Control
item.description: Weak authentication mechanisms in the industrial control series permit unauthorized access, potentially allowing attackers to manipulate critical manufacturing processes.

item.title: CVE-2026-117691 — Web Security
item.description: Keycloak's SAML HTTP-Redirect binding processes percent-encoded parameter names while signature verification checks literals, allowing attackers to forge responses and bypass authentication mechanisms entirely.

item.title: CVE-2026-89058 — Web Security
item.description: RESTEasy's CorsFilter misconfiguration reflects Origin headers alongside credentials when wildcard origins are permitted, facilitating cross-origin credential theft and malicious site interactions.

item.title: CVE-2026-137470 — Web Security
item.description: Stored XSS in SiYuan allows attackers to inject DOM event handlers via shared Markdown files, enabling arbitrary script execution in victim browsers without interaction.

item.title: CVE-2026-137494 — Web Security
item.description: Budibase's broken object-level authorization lets authenticated users reference and modify other tenants' files, posing a severe risk of cross-tenant data exfiltration.

item.title: CVE-2026-76075 — Web Security
item.description: The WordPress Warehouse Cargo theme permits arbitrary file uploads via an unverified AJAX handler, allowing unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution on vulnerable sites.

item.title: CVE-2026-137478 — Web Security
item.description: Traefik's ForwardAuth middleware fails to validate Proxy-Authorization headers alongside Authorization, enabling unauthenticated bypass of NTLM and Negotiate protections.

item.title: CVE-2026-104998 — Web Security
item.description: Missing file type validation in the WooCommerce Product Input Fields plugin permits unauthenticated attackers to upload arbitrary executable files, facilitating immediate web shell deployment.

item.title: CVE-2026-135641 — Web Security
item.description: A flawed non-empty guard condition in the WP Job Portal constructor bypasses authentication checks, allowing unauthenticated attackers to perform account takeovers and gain administrative access.

item.title: CVE-2026-136240 — Web Security
item.description: Insecure deserialization of untrusted input in the PDF Invoice plugin enables unauthenticated PHP Object Injection, providing a direct path to remote code execution on vulnerable sites.

item.title: CVE-2026-133951 — Web Security
item.description: Generation of the site-wide signing secret using PHP's non-cryptographic uniqid() function severely weakens authentication mechanisms, leading to widespread privilege escalation across WordPress installations.

item.title: CVE-2025-12543 — Web Security
item.description: Undertow HTTP server fails to properly validate Host headers, enabling cache poisoning and authentication bypass attacks against web applications.

item.title: CVE-2024-2419 — Web Security
item.description: Keycloak redirect_uri validation flaw allows OAuth token theft and user impersonation across enterprise identity and access management systems.

item.title: CVE-2026-130637 — Web Security
item.description: SEPPMAIL Secure Email Gateway suffers from pre-authentication SSTI, allowing unauthenticated attackers to disclose sensitive data and take over accounts.

item.title: CVE-2026-133336 — Web Security
item.description: ChronoForms extension allows unauthenticated arbitrary file uploads due to flawed extension checks, leading to immediate remote code execution on web servers.

item.title: CVE-2026-129411 — Web Security
item.description: Unsanitized frontend filter parameters enable unauthenticated SQL injection, allowing attackers to extract or modify sensitive database records.

item.title: CVE-2026-15369 — Web Security
item.description: The unauthenticated Store API accepts manipulated role parameters, enabling privilege escalation attacks that grant unauthorized administrative access to WordPress sites.

item.title: CVE-2026-137305 — Web Security
item.description: Unchecked file upload destinations allow attackers to place malicious Twig templates in executable directories, resulting in arbitrary server-side code execution.

item.title: CVE-2023-39417 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: PostgreSQL extension scripts containing vulnerable quoting constructs are susceptible to SQL injection, allowing attackers with database access to execute arbitrary commands and exfiltrate sensitive data.

item.title: CVE-2026-11770 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: 389 Directory Server's CleanAllRUV replication operation allows unauthenticated LDAP search filter injection, exploiting elevated replication privileges to manipulate directory state and bypass security controls.

item.title: CVE-2026-137490 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: SurrealDB's JavaScript bridge bypasses query capability gates, allowing restricted subjects to execute arbitrary database commands and escape sandbox restrictions.

item.title: CVE-2026-93569 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: Netty's HTTP/1 to HTTP/2 conversion incorrectly prioritizes conflicting Host headers over absolute-form targets, facilitating request smuggling and cache poisoning attacks.

item.title: CVE-2026-9086 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: Keycloak's client URI validation bypass enables registration of malicious redirect endpoints, which can be leveraged for credential phishing and session hijacking.

item.title: CVE-2026-60 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: 389 Directory Server's LDAP bind-rule evaluator incorrectly matches anonymous clients against empty stored attributes, granting unauthorized access to restricted directories.

item.title: CVE-2026-18922 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: Stale Cyrus SASL auxiliary properties carry forward failed bind identities onto new connections, allowing attackers to bypass authentication mechanisms and impersonate other users in 389 Directory Server.

item.title: CVE-2026-15555 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: JBoss Marshalling deserializes cluster session replication data without class filtering, enabling unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via standard gadget chains.

item.title: CVE-2026-10579 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: The Picketlink SAML handler accepts unsolicited responses without proper validation, permitting attackers to forge assertions and authenticate as any principal with unrestricted roles.

item.title: CVE-2026-0603 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: Second-order SQL injection in Hibernate's InlineIdsOrClauseBuilder allows low-privileged users to inject unsanitized characters into ID columns, extracting sensitive database contents.

item.title: CVE-2023-5869 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: PostgreSQL integer overflow during array modification permits authenticated users to execute arbitrary code within the database engine itself.

item.title: CVE-2026-135203 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: Eclipse Ditto executes untrusted JavaScript mapping scripts without sandboxing, enabling full Java object injection and remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2024-1488 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: Unbound DNS resolver misconfigures default permissions, allowing local processes to tamper with runtime configuration and disrupt DNS resolution services.

item.title: CVE-2026-86345 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: Failure to clear buffered plaintext during StartTLS negotiation enables on-path attackers to inject malicious LDAP commands after encryption is established.

item.title: CVE-2020-25720 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: Inadequate permission scoping allows delegated administrators to overwrite security-sensitive Active Directory attributes, undermining directory integrity and access controls.

item.title: CVE-2026-102010 — Other
item.description: GCC's libstdc++ priority queue erase_if function fails to update internal pointers after reallocation, creating a use-after-free condition exploitable by applications relying on standard C++ libraries for memory corruption.

item.title: CVE-2024-0562 — Other
item.description: The Linux kernel's bdi_unregister race condition during disk removal schedules bandwidth estimation work after cleanup completes, leading to use-after-free scenarios that can crash the system or leak kernel memory.

item.title: CVE-2023-39191 — Other
item.description: Inadequate validation of dynamic pointers in user-supplied eBPF programs allows attackers with CAP_BPF privileges to bypass safety checks and escalate to full system root access.

item.title: CVE-2026-13622 — Other
item.description: KubeVirt's live migration proxy dials Unix sockets via /proc paths without symlink protection, creating a container escape risk during virtual machine migrations.

item.title: CVE-2024-4467 — Other
item.description: Crafting a malicious QEMU disk image with a json:{} block device descriptor triggers excessive resource consumption or code execution on the host system via the qemu-img utility.

item.title: CVE-2026-137567 — Other
item.description: llama.cpp RPC server contains an out-of-bounds write via zero-element tensors, allowing unauthenticated heap corruption and potential RCE in AI inference services.

item.title: CVE-2024-52336 — Other
item.description: Red Hat Tuned package allows unauthenticated local users to inject and execute arbitrary scripts via D-Bus, escalating to root privileges on the host.

item.title: CVE-2024-5651 — Other
item.description: Fence Agents Remediation operator exposes an RCE primitive through unsanitized SSH/telnet path arguments, impacting cluster management and orchestration workflows.

item.title: CVE-2026-130336 — Other
item.description: Eval injection in the framework's custom method dispatcher allows attackers to execute arbitrary code within the penetration testing environment, potentially compromising host systems.

item.title: CVE-2026-137308 — Other
item.description: Weak URL validation logic in the MCP tool enables SSRF attacks using obfuscated IP formats, facilitating unauthorized access to internal network resources.
